title: Share my bet (sportsbook)

questions.title: Should the shared bet card show the stake and payout amounts?
questions.text: Should the shared bet card show the stake and payout amounts?
questions.context: The BRD says "share my bet" but doesn't say whether dollar amounts go public. Bet history shows Risk and To Win on every row (bet-history-page.tsx), and the success header reads "$5.00 to win $34.00" (soccer-betslip.tsx:446).
questions.why: This changes the card layout and adds a toggle in the share menu, or removes one.

options.label: Picks + odds, amounts off by default
options.detail: The card shows selections, odds and status. A "Show amounts" switch in the share menu adds stake and payout.

options.label: Always show amounts
options.detail: Stake and payout are always on the card. This makes for a bigger brag on wins but exposes every player's spend.

options.label: Never show amounts
options.detail: The card shows picks, odds and status only, with no toggle.

images.caption: Our bet history today: Risk / To Win

questions.title: Should the shared bet link carry the player's Refer-a-Friend code?
questions.text: Should the shared bet link carry the player's Refer-a-Friend code?
questions.context: RAF already shares a link with ?RAF=code and calls earnReferShare on Copy / Share on X (refer-a-friend-page.tsx:221, 428). The BRD doesn't say whether a bet share counts as a referral.
questions.why: If it does, a sign-up from a shared bet pays the sharer commission and the RAF page counts it. If not, the link is plain attribution only.

options.label: Yes, attach the RAF code
options.detail: Every bet share doubles as a referral and counts in Refer-a-Friend. This moves the Convert enabler most.

options.label: No, plain link with tracking only
options.detail: The link is attributed to a share for analytics but pays no commission.

questions.title: What does a friend see when they open a shared bet link?
questions.text: What does a friend see when they open a shared bet link?
questions.context: The BRD covers the sharer only. BRIEF lists #41 Back My Picks (Initiative 09) and "shareable receipts" as Later. A tap-to-bet landing pulls part of #41 forward.
questions.why: This decides whether I design one surface (the card) or two (card + a public bet page with logged-out and expired states).

options.label: Public bet page with Add to betslip
options.detail: The page shows the card plus one primary "Add to betslip". Logged-out visitors join first and then return with the picks loaded; settled bets show the result and the sportsbook.

options.label: Image only, link to sportsbook
options.detail: The post is the card image, and the link opens /sports. It's the smallest scope.

options.label: Public page, view only
options.detail: The page shows the card and a Join CTA but doesn't pre-fill a betslip.

images.caption: Sportsbook today, where a tailed bet would land

questions.answer: Public bet page with Add to betslip

proposalSummary: Revised per your pin: there's no landing page any more. The shared link opens the sportsbook for that bet's sport, with the picks already in an open betslip ready for a stake. Logged-out friends only see Join when they tap Place. Sharing stays the same: a Share icon next to My Bets on "Bets placed", and Share next to Print in Bet History. Both open the compact card with stake and payout, X / Telegram / WhatsApp / Save image, and a Copy link that carries the RAF code.

learnings.rule: Don’t: Don't send players to an in-between landing page (e.g. a public shared-bet page with the bet card and an Add to betslip button) when a link is about betting.
Do: Shared or deep links to a bet land on the sportsbook (/sports/<sport>) with the picks already in the betslip and the slip open, ready for a stake; logged-out players hit Join only at Place Bet.

proposals.summary: Players share a bet from two places: a Share icon next to My Bets on the "Bets placed" screen, and a Share button next to Print in Bet History. Both open the same compact share step: the bet card with stake and payout always shown, plus X, Telegram, WhatsApp, Save image, and a Copy link that carries the player's RAF code. On mobile the phone's own share sheet opens first. A friend who opens the link lands on a public bet page with one action, Add to betslip.
proposals.strategy: Convert enabler · Initiative 09 Sports-to-Casino, near #41 Back My Picks ("shareable receipts" in BRIEF, pulled forward from Later) · KPI #6 net revenue per active player outside casino (+5% target) and KPI #5 30-day return · Needle: shares per placed bet and RAF sign-ups from shared links, both start at 0 (new). Tracking: bet_share_opened, bet_share_channel, bet_share_link_opened, bet_share_signup.
